testEnvironment:
Test environment: the snapshot is a git repository whose single commit holds
the reviewed tree — its tree hash was compared against the commit under review
when the snapshot was cut. A suite run here collects and runs what a checkout at
that commit does, so a failing or skipped test is a fact about the tree, not
about this copy of it. Its history is that one synthetic commit: 'git log',
'git diff' and every ancestry question answer about the snapshot and never about
the PR.
The Recipe's Test entrypoint and Check step do not run these merge-gating CI steps, and nothing in this review ran them: rebase-check job (pull_request-only branch-currency assertion, not meaningful in a worktree of origin/main); proc-macos job (node --test tests/proc.test.mjs on macOS) (subsumed by the full suite on this macOS host); smoke-omp job (needs pinned omp installed via bun, absent here); install-and-smoke job (needs pinned omp installed via bun and network, absent here).

unverified.claim: I found no logic error, missed case or scope creep: all 39 added paths are allowlisted run records or review evidence of mode 100644, and finisher-scope.mjs classifies the diff as inert data.
unverified.evidence: `node probe.mjs` → `files 39 new-file-modes 39 [ '100644' ]`, `non-new hunks: 0`. Every path passed isRunRecord and isPlainFile and parsed as valid JSON. No dispositions run/dir or pr/dir mismatch. `finisher-scope.mjs --worktree $PWD --pin $PIN` against the synthetic base → `inert 0 null 39 ["data:A"]`.

unverified.claim: The committed phase0.json withholds the recipe output, and it correctly has no plugin-version sibling: the receipt's pluginVersion is null, and runArchives() writes that file only for a non-blank string.
unverified.evidence: probe.mjs reported no `RECIPE NOT WITHHELD` for phase0.json and printed `pluginVersion=null`. `readReceipt(...)` → `ok run,session,scratch,inFlight,objective,pluginVersion,steps`. run-records.mjs:108 writes plugin-version only when `typeof version === "string"`. No earlier docs/metrics/runs/* dir holds a plugin-version file either (`ls` of the last 6 run dirs).

unverified.claim: The run dir has no closeout.json, which matches phase0.mjs catchUp(): it opens a chore/run-records-* PR only when unclosedRecords() finds a run that never closed out.
unverified.evidence: `ls docs/metrics/runs/2026-11-04T072031Z` → ledger.md, phase0.json only. phase0.mjs:417-421 calls commitAndPr with stem `chore/run-records-` only when `unclosedRecords(fleetDir, records.allowed).length > 0`.

unverified.claim: The PR adds two dispositions files for PR 4320 (base and -c retry) on the same review head. They are not duplicates: the -c file differs only in per-entry reasons that record re-verification on rebased head e7abf4d7.
unverified.evidence: The head cross-check printed `4320 4320-c.json headMatch true entries 11` and `4320 4320.json headMatch true entries 11`. `diff` of the two pretty-printed files shows only `reason` lines differing ("...re-verified by fix-pr-4320-c on rebased head e7abf4d7"), plus one added reason on an applied entry.

unverified.claim: The records contain no credential-shaped strings, though 371 added lines carry absolute /Users/chris paths, as 68 of the 102 records already on main do.
unverified.evidence: A grep -Eio for ghp_/github_pat_/sk-/AKIA/key|token|secret|password=/Bearer patterns over pr.diff returned no matches. `grep -cE '^\+.*/Users/chris' pr.diff` → 371. `grep -rlE '/Users/chris' docs/metrics/reviews docs/metrics/runs | wc -l` → 68, against `git ls-files` → 102 in the snapshot.

unverified.claim: phase0.json records `status: "ok"` for steps whose output text says they did not actually run (preflight 'PREFLIGHT SKIPPED', recipe 'withheld'), so a status-only reader sees them as passed.
unverified.evidence: Ran node over phase0.json: `preflight ok "preflight.mjs passed (PREFLIGHT SKIPPED: this check set already passed ...)"`, `recipe ok "withheld: the Recipe's command lines can carry environment assignments"`. The recipe redaction is intended: tests/run-records.test.mjs line 81 asserts the RECIPE_WITHHELD output. This is a property of the existing producer, not of this PR's data, and I did not run the producer to check whether it has a way to distinguish them.
unverified.suggested_fix: No change needed for this PR. If consumers ever gate on `status`, have the producer record a distinct status (e.g. 'skipped'/'withheld') for these two steps.
